did: builder.py: added `.gitattributes` and `.gitignore` to PROTECTED so a filter or ignore rule the model wrote can no longer change what git records of the run.
builder.py: added a dotted-basename branch to Tools._writable so those two names are refused at any depth, not only at the root, while remaining readable and listable.

builder.py: ended all three git diff invocations in record_diff (HEAD patch, --no-index untracked loop, and --numstat counting) with `--`, so a file the run names `-x.txt` or `HEAD` is a path to git rather than an option or revision.

builder.py: replaced the `git config --list` probe in main with a check of git's own message, now naming a directory `not a git checkout` only for `not a git repository` or `invalid gitfile format` and carrying git's words for any other failure, so a broken .git/config is no longer misreported as no checkout.
builder.py: removed the now-unused `tempfile` import the probe had needed.
unsure: The document updates named in the goal (README.md, AGENTS.md, seed template and seeds) are assigned to the attended agent after the build; AGENTS.md already carries the old-to-new mapping sentence, and no test exercises the documents, so I left them untouched.
